name: Prestashop Store Email Marketing Automation

description: This project involves the setup of a comprehensive email marketing automation system for a Prestashop store. The goal is to enhance customer engagement and encourage repeat purchases through targeted email campaigns. The project will include the integration of an email marketing platform with the Prestashop store, the creation of automated workflows for customer segmentation, and the design of personalized email templates. Additionally, we will implement tracking mechanisms to monitor the performance of email campaigns, allowing for data-driven adjustments. The final deliverable will be a fully functional email marketing automation system tailored to the specific needs of the store, ensuring that customers receive timely and relevant communications that drive sales.

name: Prestashop Store Migration
summary: Migrate an existing eCommerce store from another platform to Prestashop while preserving all data and functionality.
description: This project involves the seamless migration of an existing eCommerce store from a different platform to Prestashop, ensuring that all data, including products, customer information, and order history, is preserved and fully functional post-migration. The process will include a thorough analysis of the current store setup, followed by the development of a detailed migration plan that outlines the steps necessary to transfer all relevant data. The migration will be executed with minimal downtime to ensure that the client’s business operations are not disrupted. Additionally, post-migration testing will be conducted to verify that all functionalities are intact and that the store operates smoothly on the Prestashop platform. This project is ideal for businesses looking to enhance their online presence with a robust eCommerce solution while ensuring a hassle-free transition.
deliverables: Successful migration of all products, customers, and orders (work)
Consultation on Prestashop features and optimizations (consultation)

name: Prestashop Store Voice Search Optimization
summary: Optimize a Prestashop store for voice search to cater to the growing number of voice-enabled device users.
description: As the use of voice search continues to rise, optimizing your Prestashop store for this technology is essential to stay competitive in the eCommerce landscape. This project will focus on enhancing the store's architecture, content, and user experience to ensure that it is fully compatible with voice search functionalities. Key tasks will include conducting a comprehensive audit of the existing store, identifying relevant keywords for voice search, optimizing product descriptions, and implementing structured data markup to improve search visibility. Additionally, we will ensure that the site’s navigation is intuitive for voice commands and that it loads quickly on all devices. The end goal is to create a seamless shopping experience for users who prefer voice search, ultimately driving more traffic and increasing conversions.
deliverables: Comprehensive audit report of the current store's voice search readiness (document)
List of optimized keywords tailored for voice search (document)
Optimized product descriptions and metadata for key products (work)
User experience recommendations for voice command navigation (consultation)
Final report summarizing changes made and expected impact (document)

summary: Create a unique and visually appealing Prestashop theme tailored to a specific brand or industry.
description: This project involves the design and development of a custom Prestashop theme that reflects the unique identity and values of a specific brand or industry. The goal is to create a visually stunning and user-friendly online store that enhances the shopping experience for customers. This project is ideal for businesses looking to establish a strong online presence through a tailored eCommerce solution.
